g.text: Source: Baird et al. (2021), Coral Spawning Database v1. Basemap: maps, projected with sf (Pacific-centred Robinson).
Natural-reef records only. One reef-night = one subsite and local date. Point area shows recorded coverage; it does not estimate reef abundance or survey effort.
